Keto Waldorf Salad
By: Keto Summit
Published: Monday, July 23, 2018 - 7:23am

Ingredients




2 cups of salad leaves of your choice
1/4 cup of paleo mayo (60 ml)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
½ Granny Smith apple (or other green apple), thinly sliced
2 stalks of celery, thinly sliced at an angle
6 grapes, quartered
30g walnuts, roughly chopped (1oz)

Preparation

1 Simply toss all the ingredients together after prepping and slicing as indicated in the ingredients list. 2 Divide between two bowls and enjoy!

About

DESCRIPTION: Enjoy it as a quick and easy side salad to accompany your steak.
